notes:
Note: 

Using Wi-Fi can deplete your battery power faster than a carrier network connection.

steps.text: Select the Wi-Fi network you'd like to connect to.
notes:
Note: 

Wi-Fi hotspots may have security limitations, requiring a password. If necessary, enter the network password.

feature_wifi_connect-connecting-to-a-wi-.category: Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth, and Browsers

feature_phone_airplane-turning-airplane-.title: Turning Airplane mode on and off
feature_phone_airplane-turning-airplane-.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Turning Airplane mode on and off

Airplane mode turns off cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth connections. (Note: You can manually turn Wi-Fi or Bluetooth back on while airplane mode is active.)

steps.text: From the Settings screen, tap Connections.
Tap or slide the Airplane mode switch to ON.
notes:
Note: 

You can also turn Airplane mode on and off through the Notification panel.

feature_phone_airplane-turning-airplane-.category: Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth, and Browsers

feature_carrier_lock_status-checking-if-.title: Checking if your phone is carrier locked
feature_carrier_lock_status-checking-if-.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Checking if your phone is carrier locked

An unlocked mobile device can be used on any available network instead of being limited to a single network. Follow along with this tutorial to identify whether or not your device has carrier restrictions.

steps.text: From the Settings app, tap Connections.
Scroll to and tap More connection settings.
On this screen, you can review your device's status.
notes:
Note:
"Unlocked": No carrier restrictions are detected. The device should be open to all networks.
"Locked": The device is restricted to its current carrier and will not recognize other providers.
"Unlocked": No carrier restrictions are detected. The device should be open to all networks.
"Locked": The device is restricted to its current carrier and will not recognize other providers.

steps.text: After you've reviewed your device's status, tap the Back icon to return to Connections.
Tap or slide the Select automatically switch to OFF.
notes:
Note: 

If your device only shows one carrier, it’s likely your device is locked to that carrier. However, if you have multiple available networks, then your device is likely unlocked.

feature_carrier_lock_status-checking-if-.category: Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth, and Browsers

feature_data_usage-managing-data-usage.title: Managing data usage
feature_data_usage-managing-data-usage.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Managing data usage

Learn how to easily check and track your data usage by following these steps.

steps.text: From the Settings app, tap Connections.
Tap Billing cycle and data warning.
notes:
Note: 

You can also turn off mobile data when you're in areas where you don't want to use any data.

steps.text: Tap or slide the Set data warning switch to ON.
notes:
Note: 

From this screen, you can limit your data usage and set up alerts for when you're reaching your data usage limits for the current month.

steps.text: Enter your preferred data usage warning.
Tap or slide the Limit mobile data usage to ON.
Enter your preferred data usage limit.
Select a new usage cycle reset date.

feature_data_usage-managing-data-usage.category: Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth, and Browsers

feature_data_restrict-reducing-data-usag.title: Reducing data usage by turning on data saver
feature_data_restrict-reducing-data-usag.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Reducing data usage by turning on data saver

Using the Data Saver function on your device can help you lower the amount of data you use. Data Saver will prevent some apps from sending or receiving data in the background.

steps.text: From the Settings app, tap Connections.
Tap or slide the Turn on now switch to ON.

feature_data_restrict-reducing-data-usag.category: Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth, and Browsers

feature_hotspot_on-setting-up-mobile-hot.title: Setting up mobile hotspot
feature_hotspot_on-setting-up-mobile-hot.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Setting up mobile hotspot

Set up your device as a Mobile Hotspot so you can share your data connection with other devices. Your device will create a Wi-Fi hotspot with its data connection. Other devices will be able to connect to the Wi-Fi hotspot.

steps.text: From the Settings app, tap Connections.
Tap your hotspot's details to open the configure screen.
notes:
Note: 

The configure screen lets you choose the type of security you want. You can also find your device password here.

steps.text: Tap or slide the Mobile Hotspot switch to ON.
notes:
Note: 

If necessary, tap OK to turn off Wi-Fi.

feature_hotspot_on-setting-up-mobile-hot.category: Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth, and Browsers

feature_dex_connect-connecting-your-devi.title: Connecting your device to a computer via Samsung DeX
feature_dex_connect-connecting-your-devi.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Connecting your device to a computer via Samsung DeX

Learn how to connect your smartphone to a computer so you can view its contents or access it using your keyboard and mouse.

steps.text: From the Start Samsung DeX popup, tap Start now.
notes:
Note: 

You are now ready to use your device with Samsung DeX on your computer.

feature_dex_connect-connecting-your-devi.category: Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth, and Browsers

feature_bluetooth_pair-pairing-with-a-bl.title: Pairing with a Bluetooth® device
feature_bluetooth_pair-pairing-with-a-bl.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Pairing with a Bluetooth® device

Connect to other devices via Bluetooth to share media such as music or videos. Bluetooth devices can be anything from your stereo in your car to a keyboard to type on your mobile device with.

steps.text: From the Settings app, tap Connections.
Tap or slide the Bluetooth switch to ON.
notes:
Note: 

The device you're pairing your phone with needs to be set to Pairing mode, or your phone won't be able to recognize it. Refer to the User Guide that came with the device to learn how to use it.

steps.text: Select the device you'd like to pair to.

notes:
Note: 

A password may be requested. Common manufacturer passwords are 0000 and 1234.

feature_bluetooth_pair-pairing-with-a-bl.category: Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth, and Browsers

feature_web_bookmark-bookmarking-a-websi.title: Bookmarking a website
feature_web_bookmark-bookmarking-a-websi.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Bookmarking a website

Customize your web browsing experience by bookmarking websites that you frequently visit for quick access.

steps.text: From the website you'd like to bookmark, tap the Menu icon.
To view your bookmarks, tap the Menu icon.
Select the folder you wish to view.
Select a bookmark to open it.
notes:
Note: 

You can also add the Bookmark widget to your Home screen for faster access to your bookmarks.

feature_web_bookmark-bookmarking-a-websi.category: Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth, and Browsers

feature_browser_settings-changing-web-co.title: Changing web content settings
feature_browser_settings-changing-web-co.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Changing web content settings

Settings that you can configure include the search engine your browser uses, auto-fill form information, saved passwords, and more.

steps.text: From the Chrome app, tap the Menu icon.
Scroll to and tap Site settings.

feature_browser_settings-changing-web-co.category: Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth, and Browsers

feature_browser_clear-clearing-browsing-.title: Clearing browsing data
feature_browser_clear-clearing-browsing-.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Clearing browsing data

Learn how to clear your web browsing history for the browser on your device.

steps.text: From the Chrome app, tap the Menu icon.

notes:
Note: 

Tap More options to view more settings.

feature_browser_clear-clearing-browsing-.category: Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth, and Browsers

feature_web_navigate-navigating-to-a-web.title: Navigating to a website
feature_web_navigate-navigating-to-a-web.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Navigating to a website

Use a browser on your device to access and navigate the internet. You can search the web or enter a URL to go directly to a webpage.

steps.text: From the Home screen, tap the Chrome icon.
Tap the Search or type web address field.
Enter the web address you'd like to visit or terms you'd like to search.

notes:
Note: 

The website or search results will display after this step.

feature_web_navigate-navigating-to-a-web.category: Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth, and Browsers

feature_web_switch-using-web-browser-win.title: Using web browser windows
feature_web_switch-using-web-browser-win.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Using web browser windows

You can switch between multiple tabs inside your web browsing app. This allows you to keep several websites open at once to quickly switch between.

steps.text: From the Chrome app, tap the Menu icon.
To close a tab, tap the Tabs icon.
Tap the X icon in the tab you'd like to close.

feature_web_switch-using-web-browser-win.category: Wi-Fi, Mobile Data, Bluetooth, and Browsers

feature_picture_size-changing-the-file-s.title: Changing the file size of pictures and videos
feature_picture_size-changing-the-file-s.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Changing the file size of pictures and videos

In the camera app's settings you can change the resolution of the pictures or videos your device will take. A lower resolution photo will take up less space on your device but may not look as good as a high resolution photo.

steps.text: From the Camera app, tap VIDEO.

feature_text_delete-deleting-texts-and-r.title: Deleting texts and reporting spam
feature_text_delete-deleting-texts-and-r.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Deleting texts and reporting spam

Learn how to remove a text from your device. Removing a text message from your device will not remove it from the device of your correspondents.

steps.text: From the Messaging app, select a conversation.
To delete the text conversation, tap Delete and follow any on-screen prompts to complete the deletion.
notes:
Note: 

You can delete individual messages by touching and holding each message you wish to delete and then tapping the Delete icon.

steps.text: To block the sender and report the message as spam, tap Block & report spam, then follow the on-screen prompts.
notes:
Note: 

Another way to report spam is by forwarding the message to 7726 (SPAM), which directs it to your wireless provider’s spam reporting service.

feature_storage_manage-managing-your-sto.title: Managing your storage space on your phone
feature_storage_manage-managing-your-sto.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Managing your storage space on your phone

Manage your storage space on your device across applications.

steps.text: From Settings, scroll to Device care.

notes:
Note: 

From this screen, you can view how much of your device's space is allocated to different file types, as well as receive personalized recommendations for managing your storage.

Note: 

Your apps' recently deleted files will be shown here, and can be deleted individually to free up space.

feature_screen_timeout-adjusting-the-scr.title: Adjusting the screen timeout and brightness
feature_screen_timeout-adjusting-the-scr.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Adjusting the screen timeout and brightness

Changing the length of time before the lock screen shows up, known as screen timeout, and brightness of your device can impact your battery life. Decreasing the time of inactivity before your device goes to sleep and lowering the brightness of your device can help extend your device's battery life.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, tap Display.
Select your preferred screen timeout duration.
notes:
Note: 

Decrease the screen timeout to help extend your phone's battery life.

steps.text: Tap the Back icon to save your changes.

notes:
Note: 

Lowering the screen's brightness can help to extend your phone's battery life.

feature_force_restart-force-restarting-y.title: Force restarting your device
feature_force_restart-force-restarting-y.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Force restarting your device

If your device isn’t responding or is completely frozen, force restarting is a great first step to take to resolve your issue. Follow along with this tutorial to learn how to properly force restart your device.

steps.text: From the Home screen, press and hold the Power and Volume Up buttons until the screen goes dark.
notes:
Note: 

Some devices may require you to press and hold the Power and Volume Down buttons instead.

feature_settings_apps-managing-app-power.title: Managing app power usage and force closing apps
feature_settings_apps-managing-app-power.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Managing app power usage and force closing apps

You can set battery usage allowances for certain apps on your device. If an app is using too much battery life or is behaving incorrectly, you can force stop the application.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, scroll to Apps.

notes:
Note: 

From this screen, you can view details about how your battery power is being used by the selected app.

feature_settings_battery-managing-the-ba.title: Managing the battery
feature_settings_battery-managing-the-ba.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Managing the battery

Learn how to manage the battery on your device. Taking care of your battery will extend your battery life.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, tap Battery.

notes:
Note: 

From this screen, you can view details about how your battery power is being used.

steps.text: Select an app to see its usage details.

feature_emergency_mode-using-power-savin.title: Using power saving mode
feature_emergency_mode-using-power-savin.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Using power saving mode

Use emergency power saving mode when your device is low on battery and you still need to be able use some functions on your device.

steps.text: From the Home screen, drag down the right side of your screen to open the Quick Settings panel.
notes:
Note: 

Power saving mode saves battery power by limiting access to certain apps, including the flashlight. You can also send your location or a text message to an emergency contact.

steps.text: To turn off Emergency mode, tap the Power saving icon again.

feature_settings_backup-backing-up-and-r.title: Backing up and restoring your phone
feature_settings_backup-backing-up-and-r.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Backing up and restoring your phone

It is a good idea to back up your device's information to the cloud regularly in case something happens to your device. Backing up your device's data to the cloud can also make it easier to set up a new device.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, scroll to Accounts and backup.

notes:
Note: 

For this instance we are tapping Back up data for Google Drive. Steps may vary depending on the account you are backing up data to.

feature_contacts_import-importing-and-ex.title: Importing and exporting contacts
feature_contacts_import-importing-and-ex.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Importing and exporting contacts

Import your contacts from a vcf file or from your SIM card. A vcf file can be exported from your old device and imported to your new device.

steps.text: From the Contacts app, tap the Menu icon.

notes:
Note: 

From here you can select where to import from and to.

feature_contacts_sync-syncing-account-co.title: Syncing account contacts
feature_contacts_sync-syncing-account-co.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Syncing account contacts

Some accounts that you have on your device will allow you to sync contacts from the email address to your device.

steps.text: From the Contacts app, tap the Menu icon.

feature_google_play_system_check-checkin.title: Checking for and installing Google Play system updates
feature_google_play_system_check-checkin.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Checking for and installing Google Play system updates

Google Play System updates address potential security issues. Familiarize yourself with how to check and install Google Play System updates on your device.

steps.text: From the Settings app, scroll to Security and privacy.
If there is an update available, tap Restart now.

feature_phone_update-checking-for-and-in.title: Checking for and installing system updates
feature_phone_update-checking-for-and-in.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Checking for and installing system updates

It's important to keep your device current with the latest features, security updates, and other critical fixes.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, scroll to Software update.

notes:
Note: 

Your options may differ from what is displayed. If necessary, tap Download and install to begin updating your device.

feature_android_version_check-checking-w.title: Checking which Android version your device is on
feature_android_version_check-checking-w.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Checking which Android version your device is on

Follow along to review what Android version you are currently running on your device. You may also be able to view other version related information such as your Android security updates, Google Play system updates, Baseband versions, and your Build number etc..

steps.text: From the Settings app, scroll to About phone.

feature_clear_app_cache-clearing-the-cac.title: Clearing the cache and data for an individual app
feature_clear_app_cache-clearing-the-cac.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Clearing the cache and data for an individual app

Clearing your app’s cache removes temporary data that is stored on the app and is often used as a troubleshooting step. On the other hand, clearing your app’s storage or data, will permanently reset your app and will cause the app to act like it did when it was initially downloaded.

steps.text: From the Settings app, scroll to and tap Apps.

notes:
Note: 

Clearing the app's storage or data will reset an app to its default state. If you only want to clear the temporary data stored on your device, then tap Clear cache instead.

Note: 

Clearing the app's storage will also clear the cache.

feature_settings_debugging-enabling-usb-.title: Enabling USB debugging
feature_settings_debugging-enabling-usb-.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Enabling USB debugging

Turn on USB Debugging to help trouble shoot your device. Once USB Debugging is turned on, you will be able to plug your device into a computer to access your device's logs.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, scroll to About phone.

notes:
Note: 

You may be prompted to enter your device PIN or password. When Developer options has been enabled successfully, you will see a message at the bottom of the screen which states Developer mode has been enabled.

steps.text: Tap or slide the USB debugging switch to ON.

feature_settings_reset-performing-a-fact.title: Performing a factory reset
feature_settings_reset-performing-a-fact.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Performing a factory reset

A factory reset will erase all data from your device and is irreversible. This is good to do if you are going to trade in or sell your device. It will wipe all of your personal information from the device.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, scroll to General management.
Scroll to and tap Factory data reset.
notes:
Note: 

Before you proceed, make sure to back up all photos, videos, and data you'd like to keep. When you factory reset your device, all your files will be deleted.

feature_android_recovery-using-recovery-.title: Using recovery mode to reset your device to factory settings
feature_android_recovery-using-recovery-.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Using recovery mode to reset your device to factory settings

Your Android's Recovery Mode can be a powerful tool for troubleshooting your device, but you'll need to navigate its menus using your device's physical buttons.

steps.text: Press and hold the Power and Volume Down buttons simultaneously.
notes:
Note: 

The device must be charged to at least 30% battery to perform a reset.

Note: 

If you're unable to reach this screen, hold down the Power and Volume Down buttons until the phone powers off.

steps.text: Press and hold both the Volume Up and Power buttons until the screen turns on.
Press the Volume Down button until you reach the Wipe data/factory reset option.
Press the Volume Down button to navigate to Factory data reset.

notes:
Note: 

After this step, the system will factory reset your device. A factory reset will delete all of your data and personalized settings and restore your device back to factory default settings.

feature_lock_shortcut-customizing-the-cl.title: Customizing the clock and shortcuts on your Lock screen
feature_lock_shortcut-customizing-the-cl.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Customizing the clock and shortcuts on your Lock screen

Some apps can be accessed quickly from your lock screen. You can change the apps that appear on the lock screen for quick access.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, scroll to Wallpapers and Style.
Drag the Clock to a new location.
Drag the white corners to resize your clock.
notes:
Note: 

You can also change the style of your clock, or hide it completely.

steps.text: Tap outside the menu to save your Clock settings.
Select the Lock screen shortcut you'd like to use.
Tap Done to save your changes.

feature_blocker_auto-enabling-auto-block.title: Enabling Auto Blocker
feature_blocker_auto-enabling-auto-block.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Enabling Auto Blocker

Learn how to enable Auto Blocker in order to further secure and protect your device.

steps.text: From the Settings app, scroll to and tap Security and privacy.
Scroll to and tap Auto Blocker.
Tap or slide the Auto Blocker switch to ON.

feature_enable_offline_device_lock-enabl.title: Enabling Offline Device Lock
feature_enable_offline_device_lock-enabl.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Enabling Offline Device Lock

Learn how to enable the offline device lock feature. If your device has been stolen this feature automatically locks your screen to help protect your data even when your device is off the grid.

steps.text: From the Settings app, scroll to and tap Security and privacy.
Tap or slide the Offline device lock switch to ON.
notes:
Note: 

The Offline device lock switch may not appear on your device if it has not been set up before. In that case, tap Offline device lock instead.

feature_enable_remote_lock-enabling-remo.title: Enabling Remote Lock
feature_enable_remote_lock-enabling-remo.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Enabling Remote Lock

Learn how to enable the remote lock feature. This will allow you to lock your device remotely in the event it is stolen.

steps.text: From the Settings app, scroll to and tap Security and privacy.
Tap or slide the Use Remote Lock toggle to ON.

feature_enable_theft_detection_lock-enab.title: Enabling Theft Detection Lock
feature_enable_theft_detection_lock-enab.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Enabling Theft Detection Lock

Learn how to enable the theft detection lock feature. This feature attempts to detect if your device might have been stolen through various aspects such as multiple incorrect PIN attempts, etc.. The device will then lock to prevent access.

steps.text: From the Settings app, scroll to and tap Security and privacy.
Tap or slide the Theft detection lock toggle to ON.

feature_screen_security-setting-screen-s.title: Setting screen security
feature_screen_security-setting-screen-s.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Setting screen security

Screen locks secure your device and protect your device from being accessed by other people. Removing your security lock will allow anyone to be able to access your device. Note that if your device is requesting a PUK code, you will need to contact your carrier to unlock your device.

steps.text: From the Settings app, scroll to Lock screen and AOD.
notes:
Note: 

This app may be called "Lock screen" on some OS versions.

Note: 

This app may be called "Lock screen" on some OS versions.

Note: 

For this tutorial, we're showing how to set up a PIN. You can select a different type of security, but steps may vary based on what you choose.

Note: 

Your PIN must be at least 4 numbers long.

feature_settings_location-configuring-lo.title: Configuring location settings
feature_settings_location-configuring-lo.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Configuring location settings

Sharing your GPS location with applications such as Maps can be turned on or off. You can change these location settings across your entire device or per app.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, scroll to Location.
Tap or slide the Location switch to ON.
notes:
Note: 

From this screen, you can choose with apps will have access to your location. If you turn Location Services off, you won't be able to use Google Maps or any other apps or features that require your location.

feature_alert_tracker-enabling-unknown-t.title: Enabling Unknown Tracker Alerts
feature_alert_tracker-enabling-unknown-t.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Enabling Unknown Tracker Alerts

Unknown tracker alerts allow you to be more aware of your surroundings and detect any unwanted tails.

steps.text: From the Settings app, scroll to Safety and emergency.
Tap or slide the Allow alerts switch to ON.

feature_find_phone-finding-your-child-s-.title: Finding your child's location
feature_find_phone-finding-your-child-s-.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Finding your child's location

Learn how to find your device. You can send a request to your device to make a sound to help you find it.

steps.text: From the Google Family Link app, tap Location.

notes:
Note: 

If you have multiple children, select which ones you want to turn on location sharing for.

feature_find_my_device-using-samsung-fin.title: Using Samsung Find to locate missing phones and accessories
feature_find_my_device-using-samsung-fin.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Using Samsung Find to locate missing phones and accessories

Follow along to use your device's tracking feature to locate, lock, or erase a missing device.

steps.text: From the Samsung Find app, select a device to view options for it.
Tap Ring to play a noise from your device to help find it.
To adjust which devices can be seen in the Find app, tap the Menu icon.
Tap Allow devices to be found.
Tap or slide Allow this phone to be found ON or OFF.
notes:
Note: 

You can also adjust this setting in Settings > Security and Privacy > Lost device protection.

feature_search_circle-using-circle-to-se.title: Using Circle to Search
feature_search_circle-using-circle-to-se.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Using Circle to Search

Circle to Search allows you to find an object from a picture by just using your finger or stylus. Circle to Search also works on text and requires you to scribble or draw on the desired text.

steps.text: From the Settings app, tap Display.
Scroll to and tap Navigation bar.
Tap or slide the Circle to Search switch to On.
Take a photo of what you would like to look for.
Tap and hold the Home icon.
Draw a circle around what you would like to search for.
notes:
Note: 

There is also a tap function that will put a crop box around the approximate area you tapped.

steps.text: Scroll up on your device to see your search results.
notes:
Note: 

You can also use this function for text as well and can either circle existing text or write your own text to be searched.

feature_rtt_tty_calling-adjusting-rtt-tt.title: Adjusting RTT/TTY calling settings
feature_rtt_tty_calling-adjusting-rtt-tt.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Adjusting RTT/TTY calling settings

Learn how to adjust your RTT/TTY calling settings. This feature allows you to communicate effectively over the phone if you are having hearing or speech difficulties.

steps.text: From the Phone app main screen, tap the Menu icon.
Scroll to and tap Real Time Text.
Choose when you would like the RTT call button to appear.

feature_display_size-adjusting-your-disp.title: Adjusting your display size
feature_display_size-adjusting-your-disp.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Adjusting your display size

You can change the display size on your screen to be larger or smaller. The display size will change the size of everything on the screen, not just the font size.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, scroll to Accessibility.

feature_accessibility_tapduration-changi.title: Changing your Tap duration
feature_accessibility_tapduration-changi.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Changing your Tap duration

You can adjust how long you need to press on your device in order for it to register as a "tap."

steps.text: From Accessibility within the Settings app, tap Interaction and dexterity.
Tap the Plus or Minus to set your tap duration.
Tap the circles to test your tap duration.

feature_accessibility_displaymode-changi.title: Changing your display mode
feature_accessibility_displaymode-changi.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Changing your display mode

You can increase the size of on-screen text using Display Mode's "Large display" option.

feature_accessibility_removeanimations-r.title: Changing your display mode
feature_accessibility_removeanimations-r.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Changing your display mode

You can increase the size of on-screen text using Display Mode's "Large display" option.

feature_accessibility_flashnotification-.title: Setting up camera flash or screen flash notifications
feature_accessibility_flashnotification-.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Setting up camera flash or screen flash notifications

Your device can flash its camera light, or the screen itself, whenever you've received a new notification.

steps.text: Tap or slide the Camera flash notification switch to ON.

feature_accessibility_highlightbuttons-t.title: Turning on Highlight buttons
feature_accessibility_highlightbuttons-t.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Turning on Highlight buttons

You can show the outlines of buttons on your device's screen to make them easier to locate and press.

feature_accessibility_spokenassistance-t.title: Turning on Spoken assistance accessibility options
feature_accessibility_spokenassistance-t.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Turning on Spoken assistance accessibility options

Your device can speak the text you're typing if you need a little help with your keyboard inputs.

steps.text: From the Settings app, scroll to Accessibility.
Scroll to Speak keyboard input aloud.
Tap or slide the Speak keyboard input aloud switch to ON.
Select what you would prefer your device to read aloud.
Tap or slide the Audio description switch to ON.

feature_accessibility_universalswitch-tu.title: Turning on Universal switch
feature_accessibility_universalswitch-tu.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Turning on Universal switch

The Universal Switch feature allows you to control your device using an external switch, head movements, or face gestures.

steps.text: From Accessibility within the Settings app, tap Interaction and dexterity.
Tap or slide the Universal switch switch to ON.
Using your universal switch, tap OK.

feature_accessibility_coloradjustment-tu.title: Turning on and changing Color adjustment settings
feature_accessibility_coloradjustment-tu.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Turning on and changing Color adjustment settings

You can modify your screen's colors to make it easier to distinguish one from another.

steps.text: Tap or slide the Color correction switch to ON.
notes:
Note: 

Turn off the Color correction switch to reset the phone to its default settings.

feature_accessibility_repeatedtouch-turn.title: Turning on and changing Ignore repeated touches settings
feature_accessibility_repeatedtouch-turn.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Turning on and changing Ignore repeated touches settings

If you're having difficulty tapping your device, you can set it to ignore multiple, unintended taps that occur within a small window of time.

steps.text: From Accessibility within the Settings app, tap Interaction and dexterity.
Tap the Plus or Minus to set your duration length.
Tap the circles to test your tap duration.

feature_accessibility_livecaption-turnin.title: Turning on and changing Live Caption settings
feature_accessibility_livecaption-turnin.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Turning on and changing Live Caption settings

With Live Caption, your device will automatically create captions for any audio that's currently playing, such as podcasts, music, and videos.

steps.text: Scroll to, then tap or slide the Hide profanity switch to ON.
Scroll to, then tap or slide the Use live Caption switch to ON.

feature_accessibility_assistantmenu-turn.title: Turning on and changing your Assistant menu
feature_accessibility_assistantmenu-turn.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Turning on and changing your Assistant menu

The Assistant Menu allows you access your device's hardware buttons and trigger gesture-based actions by tapping buttons on the screen.

steps.text: From Accessibility within the Settings app, tap Interaction and dexterity.
Select your preferred assistant menu items.
notes:
Note: 

Tapping the Minus icon on an item will remove it from your list of menu items.

steps.text: Tap or slide the Assistant menu switch to ON.

feature_accessibility_voiceaccess-turnin.title: Turning on and changing your Voice Access
feature_accessibility_voiceaccess-turnin.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Turning on and changing your Voice Access

Voice Access allows you to navigate through your device, and even launch apps, by speaking to your device instead of tapping the screen.

steps.text: From Accessibility within the Settings app, tap Interaction and dexterity.
Tap or slide the Activation button switch to ON.
Tap or slide the Voice Access switch to ON.

feature_accessibility_livetranscribe-usi.title: Using Live Transcribe
feature_accessibility_livetranscribe-usi.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Using Live Transcribe

With Live Transcribe, your device will automatically convert anything you say into text and display it on your screen.

steps.text: From Accessibility within the Settings app, tap Hearing enhancements.

notes:
Note: 

If necessary, follow the onscreen prompts to give Live Transcribe the appropriate permissions.

feature_talkback_use-using-talkback.title: Using TalkBack
feature_talkback_use-using-talkback.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Using TalkBack

Use the TalkBack function on your device to help you navigate it by touch. The device will speak what is on the screen an you can tap anywhere on the screen to tap the item that is being spoken.

steps.text: From the Settings app, scroll to Accessibility.
Scroll to and tap Advanced settings.

notes:
Note: 

From this screen, you can adjust TalkBack settings including sound volume, spoken passwords, and more.

steps.text: Tap or slide the TalkBack switch to ON.
Swipe from left to right until the TalkBack switch is selected.
notes:
Note: 

Swiping left and right navigates between items read aloud. Using two fingers allows users to scroll.

steps.text: Quickly tap the screen twice to activate the selected item.
notes:
Note: 

Performing a double-tap activates the selected item.

steps.text: Swipe from left to right until Turn off is selected.
Quickly tap the screen twice to activate the selected item.

feature_accessibility_shortcut-using-acc.title: Using accessibility shortcuts
feature_accessibility_shortcut-using-acc.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Using accessibility shortcuts

Accessibility shortcuts allow you to have direct access to certain device functions from the shortcut option. These can include swiping actions or button actions.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, scroll to and tap Accessibility.
Select a button or shortcut you would like to customize.
notes:
Note: 

From this screen you can make changes to your accessibility shortcuts.

feature_screen_magnify-using-screen-magn.title: Using screen magnification
feature_screen_magnify-using-screen-magn.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Using screen magnification

Use the magnification box to enlarge certain parts of your screen. This option can be toggled on or off in your accessibility settings.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, scroll to Accessibility.

notes:
Note: 

For this tutorial, we are demonstrating how to use magnification with a triple-tap. You can also use an accessibility button but steps may vary based on what you choose.

Note: 

You can also tap Partial screen to use a moveable magnifier window, or allow switching between both on the fly.

steps.text: Tap or slide the Magnification shortcut switch to ON.
Quickly tap three times on a region of the screen you'd like to magnify.
Quickly tap the screen three times again to zoom back out.

feature_phone_wifi-activating-wi-fi-call.title: Activating Wi-Fi calling
feature_phone_wifi-activating-wi-fi-call.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Activating Wi-Fi calling

You can use Wi-Fi calling to make and receive calls in areas with limited or no cellular connectivity. If this option is not present on your device, or cannot be enabled, your carrier's network or your specific cellular plan might not support this feature.

steps.text: From the Phone app, tap the Menu icon.
Tap or slide the Wi-Fi Calling switch to On.
notes:
Note: 

If necessary, follow onscreen instructions to enter a US address for use in the event of an emergency call. You can update this address at any time.

feature_phone_contact-calling-a-contact.title: Calling a contact
feature_phone_contact-calling-a-contact.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Calling a contact

Use your saved contacts to place a call rather than typing out their number from memory.

steps.text: From the Phone app, tap the Contacts icon.
Select the contact you'd like to call.

feature_call_forwarding-setting-up-call-.title: Setting up Call Forwarding
feature_call_forwarding-setting-up-call-.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Setting up Call Forwarding

Set up call forwarding on your device to have incoming calls routed to another number. Depending on your device you may be able to route calls differently based on whether your line is busy or not.

steps.text: From the Phone app, tap the Menu icon.
Input the number you would like to forward to.

notes:
Note: 

Follow steps 7 & 8 to update the remaining options.

feature_phone_switch-switching-between-c.title: Switching between calls
feature_phone_switch-switching-between-c.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Switching between calls

While on a phone call, you may receive a second phone call. You can put one phone call on hold and talk to other other and switch between them.

steps.text: During an ongoing call, drag the green Call icon up to answer the incoming call.
notes:
Note: 

This will put the original call on hold.

steps.text: Tap Swap to switch to the call that is on hold.
Tap the End Call icon to end the current call.
notes:
Note: 

When you end one call, you'll automatically switch to the other call that was on hold.

feature_view_blocked_list-viewing-a-list.title: Viewing a list of your blocked numbers
feature_view_blocked_list-viewing-a-list.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Viewing a list of your blocked numbers

Learn how to view a list of your blocked numbers through the phone app.

steps.text: From the Phone app, tap the Menu icon.

feature_video_call-making-a-video-call.title: Making a video call
feature_video_call-making-a-video-call.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Making a video call

Learn how to make a video call through the phone app.

steps.text: From the Phone app, enter a contact phone number.

notes:
Note: 

Video options may vary depending on carrier and location.

feature_contacts_add-adding-a-contact.title: Adding a contact
feature_contacts_add-adding-a-contact.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Adding a contact

Create a new contact to store that person's information on your device. In addition to saving their phone number, you can store information like email, address, and more.

steps.text: From the Contacts app, tap the Plus sign icon.
notes:
Note: 

If prompted, select your contact storage location.

feature_contacts_favorite-adding-and-rem.title: Adding and removing contacts from favorites
feature_contacts_favorite-adding-and-rem.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Adding and removing contacts from favorites

Update your favorites list to keep your favorite contacts easily accessible. Removing contacts from your favorites list does not remove them from your device. If the contact is stored directly on your SIM card you may not be able to add it to your favorites.

steps.text: From the Contacts app main screen, select the contact you'd like to mark as a Favorite.
Tap the Star icon to add the contact to Favorites.
notes:
Note: 

When the Star icon is yellow, that means the contact has been designated as a favorite.

steps.text: Tap the Back icon to return to the main Contacts screen.
To remove a contact from Favorites, select the contact you'd like to remove.
Tap the Star icon to remove the contact from Favorites.
notes:
Note: 

Removing a contact from your Favorites won't delete the contact from your device.

feature_contacts_ringtone-assigning-a-ri.title: Assigning a ringtone to a contact
feature_contacts_ringtone-assigning-a-ri.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Assigning a ringtone to a contact

Give your contacts unique ringtones and other personal information.

steps.text: From the Contacts app main screen, select the contact you'd like to assign a ringtone to.

feature_contacts_block-blocking-and-unbl.title: Blocking and unblocking a contact
feature_contacts_block-blocking-and-unbl.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Blocking and unblocking a contact

If you no longer want to receive text messages or phone calls from a contact, you can block their number on your device. This however does not prevent the contact from leaving voicemails.

steps.text: From the Phone app, tap the Menu icon.
Tap the Add phone number field.
Enter the phone number you'd like to block.
To remove a number from your block list, tap the Minus sign icon beside the number.

feature_rcs_chat-adjusting-rcs-chat-sett.title: Adjusting RCS chat settings
feature_rcs_chat-adjusting-rcs-chat-sett.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Adjusting RCS chat settings

Learn how to adjust your RCS chat settings. This feature will allow you to improve the quality and efficiency of your messages.

steps.text: From the Messages app main screen, tap the Account icon.

feature_text_settings-changing-message-s.title: Changing message settings
feature_text_settings-changing-message-s.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Changing message settings

Change the text messaging settings for your device. You can change your notification settings, change your default SMS app, auto-download MMS text, and more.

steps.text: From the Messages app, tap the Profile icon.
notes:
Note: 

Depending on your device, this may instead be a Menu icon.

feature_text_forward-forwarding-a-text.title: Forwarding a text
feature_text_forward-forwarding-a-text.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Forwarding a text

Learn how you can forward a sent or received text or multimedia message to another contact or phone number.

steps.text: From a text message conversation, touch and hold the message you'd like to forward.
Select a contact to send the message to.
notes:
Note: 

If necessary, select which of the contact's numbers you'd like to send the message to.

feature_text_send-sending-a-text.title: Sending a text
feature_text_send-sending-a-text.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Sending a text

Compose and send a standard SMS message with your device's text messaging app. You can send a text message to an individual or a group.

steps.text: From the Messages app, tap the Start chat icon.
When you're finished, tap the Send icon.

feature_text_voice-sending-an-audio-mess.title: Sending an audio message
feature_text_voice-sending-an-audio-mess.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Sending an audio message

Discover how to send a text message with your voice using the speech to text feature on your device.

steps.text: From the Messages app main screen, tap Start chat icon.
Tap and hold the Voice recording icon to start recording your message.
notes:
Note: 

If necessary, follow the onscreen prompts to give Messages the appropriate permissions.

steps.text: When you're finished, tap the Send icon.

feature_email_personal-setting-up-person.title: Setting up personal email
feature_email_personal-setting-up-person.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Setting up personal email

Set up your personal email account on your device so that you can access your email messages, send new emails and more. You can have mutliple email accounts on your device.

steps.text: From the Home screen, tap the Google folder.

notes:
Note: 

In this tutorial, we're using a Mail.com account. You can use a different account, but steps may vary based on what you choose.

feature_find_voicemail_number-finding-yo.title: Finding your voicemail number
feature_find_voicemail_number-finding-yo.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Finding your voicemail number

Familiarize yourself with how to easily locate your current voicemail number.

steps.text: From the Phone app, tap the Menu icon.

feature_voicemail_setup-setting-up-voice.title: Setting up Voicemail
feature_voicemail_setup-setting-up-voice.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Setting up Voicemail

Learn how to set up Voicemail so that you can store messages from calls you missed. If your Voicemail Icon does not appear try restarting your phone.

steps.text: While in the Phone app, a method to set up voicemail is by calling your voicemail inbox. To try this, tap Keypad.
Touch and hold the 1 key until the call starts, and follow the spoken prompts.
notes:
Note: 

You may also be able to dial your own phone number to call your voicemail.

steps.text: You can also set up your voicemail from the Visual Voicemail app. For this method, navigate to your apps and tap Visual Voicemail.
notes:
Note: 

Depending on your carrier, this app's name may vary, but the icon remains the same.

Note: 

If prompted, first grant the necessary permissions for the app to function.

feature_call_voicemail_inbox-calling-you.title: Calling your voicemail inbox
feature_call_voicemail_inbox-calling-you.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Calling your voicemail inbox

Follow along to learn how to easily call your voicemail inbox and listen to your messages.

steps.text: From the Phone app, touch and hold the Number 1 on the keypad to call your voicemail inbox.
notes:
Note: 

You can also enter and call your voicemail number or your own mobile number to reach your inbox.

steps.text: Once connected, you will usually be taken to the "Main Menu." To listen to your messages, press the Number 1 on your keypad.
notes:
Note: 

To access and change Personal Options like your PIN, press the Number 4 on your keypad.

steps.text: Follow along with the menu options to listen to your message.
notes:
Note: 

Here are some common keys you can use while listening to your messages.

1: Replay or rewind the message.
5: Envelope Info (Hear the date, time, and caller's number).
7: Delete the current message.
9: Save the current message.
#: Skip to the next message.
*: Cancel or return to the Main Menu.
0: Help (Hear the options repeated).
1: Replay or rewind the message.
5: Envelope Info (Hear the date, time, and caller's number).
7: Delete the current message.
9: Save the current message.
#: Skip to the next message.
*: Cancel or return to the Main Menu.
0: Help (Hear the options repeated).

feature_voicemail_delete-deleting-a-voic.title: Deleting a Voicemail
feature_voicemail_delete-deleting-a-voic.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Deleting a Voicemail

Learn how to easily clean out your voicemail inbox by deleting a voicemail message.

steps.text: From the Visual Voicemail App, touch and hold the voicemail you wish to delete.

feature_voicemail_listen-listening-to-a-.title: Listening to a voicemail
feature_voicemail_listen-listening-to-a-.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Listening to a voicemail

Follow along and familiarize yourself with how to listen to a voicemail on your device.

steps.text: From the Visual Voicemail app, select a voicemail.
Tap the Play button icon to listen to your voicemail.

feature_voicemail_save-saving-your-voice.title: Saving your voicemail messages
feature_voicemail_save-saving-your-voice.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Saving your voicemail messages

Learn how to save, share, and export important voicemails on your device with this step-by-step guide.

steps.text: From the Visual Voicemail app, touch and hold the voicemail you want to save.

notes:
Note: 

Archiving a voicemail will clear it from your voice mailbox and save the file locally to your phone.

Note: 

You can view archived voicemails in the Archive tab of the Voicemail app, or access your downloaded file directly by navigating to My Files > Internal Storage > VisualVoicemail.

steps.text: To save and share voicemails without clearing them from your mailbox, select the voicemail you want to save.
Select a destination to share your voicemail file to.
notes:
Note: 

Choose Drive as the destination to save the file to your Google account storage.

feature_video_record-recording-a-video.title: Recording a video
feature_video_record-recording-a-video.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Recording a video

Learn how you can record a video with your phone/tablets built in camera app.

steps.text: From the Home screen, tap the Camera icon.
notes:
Note: 

You can also access the Camera from the Lock screen by dragging the Camera icon up toward the top of the screen.

steps.text: Tap the Record icon to begin recording.
Tap the Stop icon to stop recording.

feature_documents_text_scan-scanning-doc.title: Scanning documents and text with your Camera App
feature_documents_text_scan-scanning-doc.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Scanning documents and text with your Camera App

Scan documents and extract desired text directly through your camera app.

steps.text: From the Camera app, tap the Quick Settings icon.
Tap or slide the Document scan switch to ON.
notes:
Note: 

You can enable Auto Scan to scan documents automatically once the camera detects them, without needing to capture the image manually.

steps.text: To scan a document, hold your phone camera up to the text in question and tap Scan.
notes:
Note: 

You can also take a photo and extract the text from it afterward.

feature_galaxy_camera-taking-a-picture-a.title: Taking a picture and changing camera modes
feature_galaxy_camera-taking-a-picture-a.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Taking a picture and changing camera modes

Learn about all the different photo modes you can access using your phone's Camera app.

steps.text: From the Camera app, tap the Shutter icon to take a picture.

feature_picture_screenshot-capturing-and.title: Capturing and viewing screenshots
feature_picture_screenshot-capturing-and.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Capturing and viewing screenshots

You can take screenshots of what is on your device. Screenshots can be viewed and shared like pictures.

steps.text: From the screen you'd like to capture, press and hold the Power button and the Volume down button simultaneously.
notes:
Note: 

Button configuration may change based on the device model.

Note: 

Screenshots are stored in the Screenshots app.

feature_picture_share-sharing-photos?top.title: Sharing Photos
feature_picture_share-sharing-photos?top.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Sharing Photos

Share photos and videos with others via Bluetooth, text message, email, Facebook and more.

steps.text: From the Home screen, tap Photos.
Select the photo you'd like to share.

notes:
Note: 

For this tutorial, we're sharing photos with Bluetooth. You can select any available share option, but steps may vary slightly depending on what you choose.

Note: 

Make sure the device you're sending photos to has Bluetooth on and is set to be discoverable or visible. Once another device is selected, your picture will automatically send.

feature_enable_high_quality_webcam-enabl.title: Enabling high-quality webcam video
feature_enable_high_quality_webcam-enabl.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Enabling high-quality webcam video

Learn how to enable the high quality webcam video feature.

steps.text: With a data-supported USB cable, connect your phone to your device.
notes:
Note: 

Your device may look different from the image shown, but the steps are the same for all Samsung models.

steps.text: On your phone, tap the USB file transfer turned on notification.

notes:
Note: 

To adjust and preview your webcam, at the top of your screen, tap the Webcam notification.

feature_instant_quick_settings-enabling-.title: Enabling Quick settings instant access
feature_instant_quick_settings-enabling-.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Enabling Quick settings instant access

Learn how to enable a shortcut that allows you to access your quick settings panel by swiping down from the top right corner of your device's screen.

steps.text: From the Home screen, drag down the right side of your screen to open the Quick Settings panel.
Tap or slide the Quick panel on left side switch to ON.
To instantly reach Quick Settings from any screen, swipe down from the top left corner of the screen.
notes:
Note: 

You can still open the Notification Panel by swiping down from other positions at the top of the screen.

feature_assistant_setup-setting-up-googl.title: Setting up Google Assistant™
feature_assistant_setup-setting-up-googl.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Setting up Google Assistant™

You can ask the Google Assistant to send emails, send texts, or start phone calls for you. In order to use the Google Assistant it needs to be set up first.

steps.text: From the Home screen, swipe up from the lower left or right corner.
notes:
Note: 

You must be signed in to a Google account to use Google Assistant.

feature_application_language-changing-a-.title: Changing a language for an application
feature_application_language-changing-a-.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Changing a language for an application

Learn how to customize the language for specific apps, instead of the entire operating system.

steps.text: From Settings, scroll to General management.

feature_language_change-changing-the-lan.title: Changing the language
feature_language_change-changing-the-lan.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Changing the language

Follow these quick steps to update your default language settings.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, scroll to General management.

notes:
Note: 

Depending on your device, you can also drag your preferred language to the top of the list and tap Apply to set it as default.

feature_theme_change-changing-the-theme.title: Changing the theme
feature_theme_change-changing-the-theme.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Changing the theme

Changing the theme of your device will adjust the look of your whole device, not just the home screen wallpaper. Themes can change the wallpaper, text size, and more.

steps.text: From the Home screen, touch and hold an empty space.
Once the download is complete, tap Apply.

feature_wallpaper_change-changing-the-wa.title: Changing the wallpaper
feature_wallpaper_change-changing-the-wa.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Changing the wallpaper

The background image for your device, also known as the wallpaper, can be changed in settings. You can use your own image as a wallpaper or choose from the default images on your device. You can change the lock screen and home screen backgrounds.

steps.text: From the Home screen, touch and hold an empty space.

notes:
Note: 

For this tutorial, we're selecting static wallpapers. Live wallpapers move on their own and add motion to your Home screen. You can also select one of your own images from the Gallery app.

steps.text: Select the wallpaper you'd like to use.
notes:
Note: 

For this tutorial, we're changing the wallpaper on the Home screen. You can also change the wallpaper on the Lock screen.

feature_panel_customize-customizing-your.title: Customizing your Notification panel
feature_panel_customize-customizing-your.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Customizing your Notification panel

Learn how to edit your notifications panel to customize it to your needs. You can rearrange the icons in the notification panel.

steps.text: From the Home screen, drag down the right side of your screen to open the Quick Settings panel.

notes:
Note: 

For this tutorial, we are customizing the Notification Panel. You can customize the order of your Notification Panel and Quick Settings icons separately.

steps.text: To remove a tile, tap the Minus icon next to it.
Tap Done to save your changes.
To add a tile, tap Add a control.
Drag the tile to a new location.
Tap Done to save your changes.

feature_screen_add-adding-and-deleting-h.title: Adding and deleting Home screens
feature_screen_add-adding-and-deleting-h.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Adding and deleting Home screens

Learn how to create or remove homescreens to further personalize your device. New home screens can be used for widgets or apps. Change the home screen to best suit your needs.

steps.text: From the Home screen, place two fingers on the screen and pinch in.
Swipe to the Plus sign panel.
Tap the Home icon to view your new Home screen.
To remove a Home screen, place two fingers on the screen and pinch in.
Tap the Home icon to save your changes.

feature_widget_add-adding-apps-and-widge.title: Adding apps and widgets to the Home screen
feature_widget_add-adding-apps-and-widge.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Adding apps and widgets to the Home screen

Widgets allow you to do things such as preview upcoming events, see recent emails, and get quick access to your favorite contacts. Widgets are also known as modules and help you keep important information at the tips of your fingers.

steps.text: From the Home screen, touch and hold an empty space.

notes:
Note: 

For this tutorial, we're adding a widget to the Home screen. You can also add an app by touching and holding an app in the Apps menu.

steps.text: Tap the widget you'd like to add.
notes:
Note: 

Scroll to view more available widgets.

feature_folders_add-adding-folders-to-th.title: Adding folders to the Home screen
feature_folders_add-adding-folders-to-th.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Adding folders to the Home screen

Combine apps into folders so they are in easy to manage app groups. You can name app folders to for help organize them.

steps.text: From the Home screen, touch and hold an app.
Drag the app on top of another app.
Enter a name for the folder.
Tap outside the folder to save your changes.
notes:
Note: 

To remove an app from the folder, touch and hold an icon, and then drag it out of the folder.

feature_phone_ringtone-changing-the-ring.title: Changing the ringtone
feature_phone_ringtone-changing-the-ring.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Changing the ringtone

You can personalize the sound your device makes when you receive a phone call, email, or text message. Learn how you can change your default ringtone.

steps.text: From the Settings screen, tap Sounds and vibration.
Select the ringtone you'd like to use.
Tap the Back icon to save your changes.

feature_disable_global_keyboard_haptics-.title: Globally disabling haptic feedback for all keyboards
feature_disable_global_keyboard_haptics-.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Globally disabling haptic feedback for all keyboards

Learn how to disable haptic feedback for all your device's keyboards.

steps.text: From the Settings app, tap Sounds and vibration.
Tap or slide Samsung Keyboard switch to OFF.

feature_settings_volume-setting-your-vol.title: Setting your volume levels with the volume panel
feature_settings_volume-setting-your-vol.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Setting your volume levels with the volume panel

Learn how to adjust the volume of your device.

steps.text: Tap a Volume button on the side of your device.
notes:
Note: 

Your device may look different from the image shown, but the steps are the same for all Samsung models.

Note: 

From this screen, you can switch media output and set volume levels for each media, calls, notifications, and more.

feature_do_not_disturb-turning-do-not-di.title: Turning Do Not Disturb on or off
feature_do_not_disturb-turning-do-not-di.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Turning Do Not Disturb on or off

Do Not Disturb (DND) allows users to silence incoming calls and notifications temporarily, sending them directly to voicemail or marking them as missed.

steps.text: Swipe down from the top right of the screen to open the Quick settings menu.

155859-can-t-make-or-receive-calls.intro:
Galaxy A15 5G
Can't make or receive calls

Not being able to make or answer calls leaves you cut off from important contacts and emergency services. Checking your network connection and SIM settings helps fix dropped calls and gets your phone working normally again.

choices: I only have one SIM active (physical or eSIM)

steps.text:
If you can't make calls on your device, a few quick checks will help you determine if the problem is with your device or your plan, and whether it's temporary or something that needs a fix.
Within this guide, you'll learn how to:
Check your existing connection
Set a default number for your Dual-SIM setup (if applicable)
Use Airplane Mode to "reset" your connection
Restart your device
Check for updates
Reset your network settings
Find additional support to address your problem

Check your connection
Check the cellular signal status icon in the upper-right corner of your phone. Generally, the more bars that are displayed, the better the connection; if you have low or no signal, that may be the reason why you're experiencing issues making phone calls.
If you're connected to Wi-Fi, you'll also be able to view your signal strength in the same area. Enabling Wi-Fi calling may help you place phone calls in areas with limited or no cellular coverage.
Note: Wi-Fi Calling availability depends on your carrier and device model. If you don't see the option anywhere, it may not be supported.
To proceed to the next step, choose the option that's correct for you.

Use Airplane Mode to reset your connection
Sometimes your phone shows a strong signal or Wi-Fi connection, but calls still won't go through. Airplane Mode may clear this up without a full restart.
Turning on Airplane Mode disconnects your phone's wireless radios, cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth. When you turn it back off, your phone re-registers with the nearest cell tower from scratch, rather than continuing to use whatever connection it had before.
To try this:
Turn on Airplane Mode.
Wait about 15 seconds.
Turn Airplane Mode off.

Try restarting your device
Manually restarting your device may help solve any connectivity issues you're experiencing. It's a great "first-step" troubleshooting technique for most issues you encounter on your device.

steps.text:
Check for updates
Make sure your device is running the latest software version available. Software updates may fix underlying bugs, including ones affecting calls.
links: Checking for and installing system updates

steps.text:
Reset your network settings
Resetting your network settings clears out your phone's saved connection info and lets it start fresh, often fixing problems that Airplane Mode or a restart couldn't.
Before you reset, write down anything you'll need to re-enter, since this action erases:
Wi-Fi passwords
Bluetooth pairings
VPN settings
APN (Access Point Name) settings, if you entered these manually to connect to your carrier's cellular network
You'll be able to resync your Wi-Fi passwords, but the other settings will need to be entered again.
If you had to enter APN settings manually to access a cellular network, you'll need to do that again before attempting a phone call.
links: Resetting network settings

steps.text:
Get additional support
If you're still having issues making a phone call on your device, you should contact your carrier for additional support. They'll be able to help identify if there is an issue on their end that's affecting your calls (e.g. a problem with your account, your SIM, or even a local cellular tower).
It's also possible your device has a hardware issue. To check, run the Phone Diagnostics tool in the Samsung Members app, it can help you pinpoint the problem and figure out what to do next.
